 Malik Monk drops 24 points Monday 
 by Ari Koslow | Kings Correspondent | Tue, Nov 3rd 2026, 1:55am EST 
 Malik Monk scored 24 points (9-14 FG, 5-8 3PT, 1-2 FT) to go along with one rebound, seven assists and one block in the Kings 115-100 win over the Mavericks. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Monk posted by far his best performance of the season in Monday's win. He'll continue to hold value in deeper leagues if he continues to play at least 30 minutes.
